translations.source_sense_description: Wirtschaft: eine Allokation vornehmen, (finanzielle) Mittel zuweisen oder verteilen

examples.text: Řízení kvality je manažerský přístup, který zajišťuje potřebnou organizační a procesní strukturu, navrhuje cíle a alokuje zdroje potřebné pro vytvoření předmětu nebo služby, jejíž vlastnosti budou podřízené požadovanému standardu kvality.

glosses: To set aside for a purpose.

examples.text: Please do not eat the meringue, as it is allocated for the dinner party tomorrow.
By March 1994, it had moved to Cardiff Canton, and was still allocated there when its nameplates were taken off in March 1997.

glosses: To distribute according to a plan, generally followed by the adposition to.

examples.text: The bulk of K–12 education funds are allocated to school districts that in turn pay for the cost of operating schools.

glosses: To reserve a portion of memory for use by a computer program.

examples.text: The memory manager allocates memory to requesting processes until there is no more memory available or until there are no more processes waiting for memory.

glosses: A writ authorizing payment, allowance, grant.

examples.text: Si le gouvernement alloue aux membres du haut clergé des traitements supérieurs à ceux du clergé subalterne, c'est qu'il le veut bien.

glosses: Assigner, affecter, une chose à quelqu'un ou à une autre chose.

examples.text: Le traitement que le budget alloue à ces fonctionnaires.
